globalAlert.title: Partial Trail & Nature Center Closures
globalAlert.message: Southwest trails, the southern bog trail & boardwalk, and the Charles Banks Belt Nature Center are temporarily closed. Visit the open Temporary Office / Education Cottage beside the parking lot — all standard loops and custom walks automatically detour onto open trails.

nature-center.name: Charles Banks Belt Nature Center
nature-center.note: Closed for major renovation and expansion. Please visit the open Temporary Office / Education Cottage right beside the parking lot.

education-cottage.name: Temporary Office / Education Cottage
education-cottage.note: Open right beside the parking lot — temporary home for Refuge staff and Nature Center animals during renovations.

restrooms.name: Outdoor Restrooms
restrooms.note: Open daily from sunrise to sunset.

animal-complex.name: Outdoor Wildlife Complex
animal-complex.note: Open daily from sunrise to sunset at no charge.
